corpus: COMMERCIAL PROPERTY POLICY SUMMARY (illustrative only). Policy Number NM-CP-48217. Named Insured: Cedar Point Logistics LLC. Insurer: Northfield Mutual Insurance Company. This summary describes the coverages, limits, deductibles, and exclusions applicable to the location at 4400 Harborview Industrial Park. SECTION I, PROPERTY COVERAGES. Building coverage is subject to a per occurrence limit of $2,500,000. The building coverage deductible is $10,000 per occurrence. Building coverage carries a coinsurance requirement of 90 percent, and failure to maintain that percentage of insurance to value at the time of loss will result in a coinsurance penalty applied to any claim payment. Business personal property coverage is subject to a per occurrence limit of $750,000, covering furniture, fixtures, inventory, and equipment owned by the named insured. The business personal property deductible is $5,000 per occurrence. Business income coverage responds to the actual loss of business income sustained during the period of restoration, subject to an annual aggregate limit of $500,000. The business income waiting period is 72 hours from the time of direct physical loss before coverage begins to accrue. Equipment breakdown coverage is subject to a per occurrence limit of $250,000 for covered mechanical and electrical breakdown of boilers, machinery, and electronic equipment. The equipment breakdown deductible is $2,500 per occurrence. SECTION II, WEATHER AND CATASTROPHE PERILS. For locations designated coastal zone, the wind and hail deductible is 5 percent of the building limit, applied separately from the standard property deductible and calculated at the time of loss. For locations designated inland zone, the wind and hail deductible is 2 percent of the building limit, applied separately from the standard property deductible. Flood is subject to a sublimit of $100,000 in the annual aggregate across all coverages combined. Flood is excluded unless purchased by endorsement, and no such endorsement is attached to this policy. Earthquake is excluded under the base policy and is not covered absent a separate earthquake endorsement purchased by the named insured. SECTION III, ADDITIONAL COVERAGES. Ordinance or law coverage, which pays the increased cost of construction to comply with current building codes after a covered loss, is subject to a per occurrence limit of $250,000. SECTION IV, LIABILITY. General liability coverage is subject to a per occurrence limit of $1,000,000 for bodily injury and property damage arising from the named insured's operations at the covered location.
